qa_rules.Condition / check: Primary key non-null, unique and immutable; referenced parent records exist.
qa_rules.Required action: Reject orphan/duplicate records; preserve source snapshot.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: All linked entities belong to the same patient and procedure, except an explicitly longitudinal identity link.
qa_rules.Required action: Reject cross-patient or cross-procedure attribution.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Individual-node correspondence is not assumed from matching station numbers.
qa_rules.Required action: Use station-level or uncertain attribution until correspondence is established.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Time-varying risk factors refer to an assessment before/on the index procedure.
qa_rules.Required action: Store separate dated snapshots; never overwrite historical case mix.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Operator case counts and case sequence exclude future procedures.
qa_rules.Required action: Freeze pre-index exposure; do not use current career totals retrospectively.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Intent and prespecified biopsy targets are retained even after plan changes or aborted attempts.
qa_rules.Required action: Preserve flow denominators and reason for nonperformance.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Surveyed, visualized, sampled and adequate are distinct states.
qa_rules.Required action: Do not infer sampling from survey, or negative cytology from absent sampling.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Adequate nonmalignant nodal result has documented adequacy basis; malignant positivity need not include benign lymphocytes.
qa_rules.Required action: Flag unsupported negative adequacy; do not reject unequivocal malignancy solely for absent lymphocytes.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: N-category interpretation uses the correct primary, laterality, edition and staging phase.
qa_rules.Required action: Reject staging derivations with unresolved tumor context; EBUS alone is not a surgical pTNM assessment.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Systematic-staging eligibility is evaluated independently of imaging-positive nodal disease.
qa_rules.Required action: Include eligible cN0 cases; record the eligibility and completeness rule version.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Single-pass records and reported aggregate acquisition counts cannot be mixed and double-counted.
qa_rules.Required action: Sum reported counts with granularity tags; do not fabricate pass details.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: A pass can be split and multiple passes pooled; links and allocation fractions are coherent.
qa_rules.Required action: Use the junction; reject fractions outside 0–100 and flag incompatible totals.
qa_rules.Execution status: Specified rule, not executed against patient data

qa_rules.Condition / check: Mixed-target or ambiguous labels do not confer a separate diagnosis to each possible target.
qa_rules.Required action: Exclude from attributable target yield pending adjudication; retain patient-level result.
